metadata.title: Fix native Bun PTY /help renderer crash

work.objective: Fix the real OpenTUI/Bun renderer crash triggered by /help and make the dialog open, close, and process Ctrl+C correctly in a native PTY.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.
Only modify packages/cli/src/ui/opentui/**; do not modify Ink, renderer dispatch, dependencies, lockfiles, Marshal state, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed relative-path equivalent or report blocked.
Do not satisfy this task with mocked renderer tests alone; preserve the real Bun PTY reproduction.
context: Real reproduction on commit fac22d00f: QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui bun packages/cli/dist/index.js renders the initial UI. Sending /help then Enter crashes the React renderer with: TextNodeRenderable only accepts strings, TextNodeRenderable instances, or StyledText instances, from @opentui/core TextNode.ts appendInitialChild.
After the render error, the first Ctrl+C did not exit; the process required external termination. Both the dialog render and clean exit behavior are blocking.

Inspect help-overlay.tsx for children invalid under @opentui/react's real reconciler, especially nested text elements or mixed child types. Compare with supported OpenTUI React text/span composition rather than assuming React DOM semantics.
The initial banner/input/status screen already works under Bun. Preserve it and all existing command/dialog wiring.
Add focused regression coverage and ensure /help opens in the built CLI under a real PTY, shows its help footer, Esc closes it, and Ctrl+C exits without a native error.
nonGoals: Do not fix the Node 24 native FFI runtime guard in this run.
Do not port additional dialogs or commands.
Do not work on the parity harness or Solid.
